name: Camp Lake Park
note: Beaver County campground on the east shore of Camp Lake, run by a county contractor: 71 sites along two roads and a south loop, 19 of them powered, plus 11 extra-large G sites; from 2026 sites 43-55 are sold only as seasonals. The two swim beaches and the boat launch are day-use areas, and 19 sites (mostly the powered ones) take a 2-night minimum online while the rest sell single nights. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Beaver County Camp Lake Park page (rendered 2026-11-10): county campground for tents and RVs, 2026 season May 14 - Sep 7, online booking via Let's Camp from March 1, seasonal sites 45-55 new for 2026 at $1,500; Let's Camp API camps/camp-lake-campground + /sites (read 2026-11-10): live, online bookings on, 71 sites all allowing RV, site lengths 22-130 ft (all but one 26 ft or more; 58 not tagged Seasonals), 19 with 30-amp, rules name the County and its Campground Contractor; Let's Camp site map + Esri imagery 2026-11-10: gravel pads along two parallel roads and a south loop with RVs parked -> real drive-in county campground a 23-ft rig fits. Public: no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery 2026-11-10 (3 km, 800 m frames around 53.12691,-111.52463 and z18 tiles at 53.12851,-111.52542 and 53.12603,-111.52663, all rendered): the west-road sites sit behind a continuous ~30-50 m treeline along the Camp Lake shore, and the open shore points are the north beach day-use clearing and the south beach / boat launch / day-use lot, with the south loop behind them. Let's Camp site text calls G9 'Beach front' and G1 'next to the beach', but the beaches are the campground's own day-use swim beaches (Beaver County map labels them Day Use), so sites behind them are not on-water, and no RV site shows open ground to the water. No filtered-view site confirmed -> not waterfront.
fees_source: https://letscamp.ca/camps/camp-lake-campground (rendered 2026-11-10): 'Price starting at $30 CAD/night', bookings closed for the off-season; https://www.albertacampgroundguide.ca/campgrounds/camp-lake-park (read 2026-11-10, undated): No Services $30.00, Power Only $36.00, before GST, subject to change.
flags: Not on RV Life (Algolia radius 20 km finds only 9051 Eastview, ~17 km west).

nightly_high $36 (power) comes from an undated Alberta Campground Guide listing; the $30 low matches Let's Camp's live 'from' price. The county page posts no nightly rates; the Let's Camp per-site rates read 0 off-season.
Min stay is per site: 19 of 71 sites carry minNights 2 on Let's Camp, 52 sell one night, so no standing booking.min_stay was set.
Seasonal sites: the county page says 45-55 and also '46 through 55'; Let's Camp tags 13 sites (43-55) Seasonals. About 58 of 71 stay nightly.
Hookups: electric 30 at 19 sites (some G1 plugs are 15-amp), no water or sewer at any site; sani dump on site.
Season 2026: May 14 - Sep 7 (county page). Phone 780-336-3414 is the in-season campground line; off-season (Oct-Apr) is the Beaver County office, 780-663-3730.
